name: Mailroom - Email Triage and Reply Drafts

parameters.content:
## MAILROOM
Email triage for a shared Gmail inbox: urgent alerts, labels, lead ledger, reply drafts.

**Before the first run**
1. Create the Google Sheet with tabs: Settings, Leads, Human Review, Error Log.
2. In 'P0 - Config' set sheet_id and ntfy_topic (a long random name).
3. Pick your credentials on any node showing a warning.
4. Click 'Manual Test Run' once, check Gmail, then activate.

Change behaviour in the Settings tab, not in nodes.
Nothing is ever sent automatically: replies are drafts only.

## PART 0 - SETUP
Triggers, settings from the Google Sheet, and Gmail label bootstrap (missing Mailroom labels are created automatically). The Error Trigger re-uses this Config node so there is one place to edit.

## PART 1 - INTAKE
Fetch inbox mail without Mailroom-Done/Failed, read each message, clean it, keep one email per conversation, skip bounces and auto-replies, then handle one email at a time.

## PART 2 - ANALYZE
One AI call returns category, urgency, summary and lead fields. The result is validated: bad or low-confidence answers become Needs Human Review.

## PART 3 - LABEL AND ALERT
Apply the category label (plus Urgent), then send one ntfy alert for urgent mail. A failed alert is logged and retried next run; it never blocks Parts 4 and 5.

## PART 4 - RECORD
Leads: clean, look up by email, append new or update existing (status is never overwritten). Needs Review: upsert into Human Review by message ID.

## PART 5 - DRAFT AND COMMIT
Write a category-specific reply, save it as a threaded Gmail draft (no send node exists), then label the email Done and take the next one.

## ERROR LANE
Any failure inside the loop lands here: log it, mark Mailroom-Retry on the first failure, Mailroom-Failed plus a phone alert on the second, then continue with the next email.
